data.name: Gate: Beyond
data.detailed_description:
Our game is a PC game with mouse movement. Inspired by classic Action RPGs, but also reinvents many core rules. Items don't require a level to use. Attributes have the same familiar point distribution but behave in new and different ways. Skill trees are not separated by class, but by masters, allowing you to discover more skill trees. There is no main quest, only big and small quests. Grind creatures for their rare drops and rise through the ranks of the Adventurers' Guild.

The game is still in development. Below is a list of features currently available in the game.

FEATURES

  • Multi-Class: Combine and unlock Skills from 5 different skill trees provided by Class master. Base classes include Hunter, Sword Mage, Academy Path, Monk, Knight.

  • Quests with Choice and Consequence - You will face tough decisions that leave significant impacts upon the world. Like unlocking merchants, skill trees, maps. Currently 6 quests are available.

  • Attributes - Attributes represent your potential and not your power. Level, Skills and items make you stronger.

  • Item & Skills Synergy - Skills require signatures to be used. Equip Weapons and Items with multiple signatures like slashing and magic to be able to enchant your weapon with fire. Or simply equip a shield to cast "Shield Up" and gain temporary armor.

  • Items

    • miscellaneous: Used for quests, NPC deliveries, trading, and crafting new equipment.

    • Consumables: Single-use items that grant healing, mana recovery, buffs, and temporary skills.

    • Equipment Items: Customize your character with up to 11 equippable item slots, including 2 weapon slots for dual wielding, shields, or magical artifacts.

  • Classic ARPG Combat: Inspired by old-school MMORPGs, explore freely and challenge any enemy, but careless fights may kill you, forcing you to rethink your strategy and return stronger.

  • Creatures: Monsters use a variety of spells and have different behaviors 

  • Locations: Explore 5 interconnected maps and a city hub within the currently available region.

    More content is being made, the list above is the content that already exists.

data.short_description: Classic Action RPG with open world exploration. Level up attributes and upgrade your spells, hunt rare items, discover powerful gear, use skills from any class, wield any weapon, and create your own build. Face challenging bosses, complete engaging quests, and rise through the Adventurers’ Guild.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 370
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
